title: Just launched a roguelike deckbuilder after a couple weeks with GPT 6 Astra
author: Material-Watercress1
selftext:
My inspiration was a mix of Magic the Gathering and Balatro/Slay the Spire with big satisfying combos and unexpected synergies.

The biggest challenges have been creating interesting cards, gameplay systems, and balancing each faction and designing a good challenge curve without there being unwinnable seeds.

comments.author: deezwhatbro
comments.body: Astra has only been out for about a week…

replies.author: Material-Watercress1
replies.body: Had the idea before Astra but it helped take it to the next level, especially did good aligning the art direction

replies.author: deezwhatbro
replies.body: Ok, then fix your header/title because it’s completely misleading.

comments.author: ericoinen
comments.body: how did you end up catching the unwinnable seeds, some bot playing thousands of runs or just playing it a lot yourself?

replies.author: Material-Watercress1
replies.body: Simulating thousands of runs with a basic AI player, then looking through all of the losses and running Astra through them to brute-force alternative playstyles and checking how many recovered. With the breadth of options in each run it is hard to prove that a seed is unwinnable, more like a solution just hasn't been found yet.

comments.author: Upstairs_West6628
comments.body: This looks great! Can’t speak on gameplay yet but the art style is very consistent throughout and doesn’t look like typical slop. Did you draw them yourself or did you at least take over creative design in some way? It’s pretty hard to get consistent styled images using local diffusion models or gpt image.
